main_window_with_properties.description: The main Eye of GNOME window is open showing an image and a right-side Properties pane. The top bar includes zoom controls, fullscreen, and a hamburger main menu.

main_menu_open.description: The Eye of GNOME main window is visible with the image and Properties sidebar, and the hamburger main menu is open as a dropdown. The menu reveals several top-level commands including Open, Save, slideshow options, and a Show submenu.

show_submenu_open.description: The Eye of GNOME main window remains open with the Properties side pane visible, and the Show submenu is expanded from the main menu. The submenu offers visibility toggles for Side Pane, Image Gallery, and Status Bar.

show_submenu_with_gallery_open.description: The Eye of GNOME window shows the image with both the Properties side pane and the bottom Image Gallery visible. The Show submenu is open, listing visibility toggles for Side Pane, Image Gallery, and Status Bar.

show_submenu_with_gallery_statusbar_off.description: The Eye of GNOME window shows the image with the Properties side pane and bottom image gallery visible. The Show submenu is open, and Status Bar is now unchecked while Side Pane and Image Gallery remain enabled.

main_window_gallery_properties_no_status.description: The main Eye of GNOME window is visible with the image, the right-side Properties pane, and the bottom Image Gallery. The status bar is hidden and no menu is currently open.

main_window_gallery_no_statusbar_no_menu.description: The main Eye of GNOME window shows the image with the Properties sidebar and bottom image gallery visible, while the status bar remains hidden. No menu is currently open.

main_window_gallery_properties_no_status.description: The main Eye of GNOME window shows the image with the Properties sidebar on the right and the Image Gallery strip at the bottom. No menu is open, and the status bar remains hidden.
